---

<!--
Before submitting, please check:

1. Search existing icons first: https://github.com/amr-elmahdy/charmly/blob/main/docs/ICONS-LIST.md
2. Confirm the icon isn't already in the library under a different name.
3. Icons can come from any source, as long as the license allows
redistribution. theSVG, Devicon, and Simple Icons are commonly used
sources, but they are not the only options.
-->

## Icon name

<!--
The slug that will be used in the API. Lowercase, no spaces.
Example: `javascript`, `react-native`, `c-sharp`
-->

## Display name

<!-- How the icon should be labeled. Example: "JavaScript", "React Native", "C#" -->

## Category

<!--
Which section should this icon go under?
Examples: Languages, Frontend, Backend, Databases, DevOps & Cloud, AI/ML,
Mobile, Game Dev, Tools, Testing, OS, Security, Blockchain
-->

## Source

<!--
Where can the SVG be found? Provide at least one direct link to the SVG
file, plus the source page if available. Common sources include theSVG,
Devicon, and Simple Icons, but any source works as long as the license
allows redistribution.
-->

- [ ] theSVG
- [ ] Devicon
- [ ] Simple Icons
- [ ] Official brand assets
- [ ] Custom SVG
- [ ] Other (explain below)

**Direct SVG link:**

```

https://...

```

**Source page:**

```

https://...

```

## License

<!--
Some icon sets have strict licenses. Charmly only ships icons that
allow redistribution.
-->

- [ ] CC0 (public domain)
- [ ] MIT
- [ ] Apache-2.0
- [ ] CC BY
- [ ] CC BY-SA
- [ ] Other (explain below)
- [ ] Unknown

## Why should this icon be added?

<!--
One or two sentences. Is it a widely-used tool? Missing from the current list?
Requested by many users? Part of a category that needs more coverage?
-->

## Checklist

- [ ] I searched ICONS-LIST.md and this icon is not already there
- [ ] The icon is not already available under a different slug
- [ ] I provided a direct SVG link
- [ ] The license allows redistribution
- [ ] The icon represents a real tool, language, or platform

## Additional context

<!--
Screenshots, references, related icon requests, or anything else useful.
-->
